# Native stacks are updated after submitting a stack (if supported).

as 'Test <test@example.com>'
at '2026-08-05T12:00:00Z'

cd repo
git init
git config spice.forge.shamhub.stacks on
git commit --allow-empty -m 'Initial commit'

shamhub-setup
shamhub new origin alice/example.git
shamhub register alice
git push origin main
env SHAMHUB_USERNAME=alice
gs auth login

git add bottom.txt
gs bc bottom -m 'Add bottom'
git add top.txt
gs bc top -m 'Add top'

gs downstack submit --fill
stderr 'Created #1'
stderr 'Created #2'

shamhub dump stacks alice/example
cmpenvJSON stdout $WORK/stacks.json

-- repo/bottom.txt --
bottom
-- repo/top.txt --
top
-- stacks.json --
[
  {
    "number": 1
  },
  {
    "number": 2,
    "base": 1
  }
]
